useCase: 检测合成图像、背景替换和多源图像组装
mechanism: 分析 transition boundaries 之间 potential spliced regions for unnatural edges, 噪声水平 discontinuities, and 光照 direction 不一致. 使用 sliding window approach to segment and compare local image statistics.
accuracy: Medium - 75-85% depending on 拼接 quality and post-processing applied
name: 拼接检测
parameters: 窗口大小: 64x64, Overlap: 50%, Noise model: Gaussian, Boundary 检测: Canny edge with 自适应 阈值
description: 识别 regions spliced from different sources 通过分析 boundary 不一致, 噪声水平s, and 光照 differences 跨 image regions.

references.title: Hsu, Y.F. & Chang, S.F. (2006). Detecting Image Splicing Using Geometry Invariants and Camera Characteristics Consistency. IEEE ICME.
Dong, J. et al. (2013). CASIA Image Tampering Detection Evaluation Database. IEEE ChinaSIP.

strengths:
• 检测 composite images from multiple sources
• 分析 both noise and 光照 consistency
• Can localize spliced boundaries
• Effective for manual 图像篡改
limitations:
• Skilled compositing can minimize boundary 伪影
• Uniform backgrounds reduce 检测 capability
• Heavy blur/feathering masks splice boundaries
• Full-image AI generation has no splice boundaries
